name: ah_tips
objective: Sources: ConquestCapped Auction House guide (Nov 13-16), Blizzard Nov 10 hotfixes.
pages: A stack posted in Orgrimmar shows in Thunder Bluff and Undercity at the same moment.
Faction houses keep 5% of a sale. Neutral houses (Gadgetzan, Booty Bay, Everlook) keep 15%.
You only get it back if the item sells. The minimum deposit dropped to 1 copper in the Nov 10 hotfixes.
Buyers get items instantly. Your gold arrives by mail about an hour later.
If the sale after the cut is worth less than the vendor price, just vendor it.
Ore, herbs and cloth sell cheapest first. Matching the lowest price puts you in line; undercutting by a copper rarely pays.
Price where most listings sit, not at the cheapest outlier.
Post in the evening. Prices tend to be higher before raid nights.
Early tooltip prices swing fast. Check the market yourself before big trades.
Lesser and Greater Magic Wands were saturated in week one.
Leather, cloth and leveling potions have held their value.
Park one in the capital closest to the Auction House, bank and mailbox.
